rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Great Scott
rows.Origin: Discovered by Don and Paula Ballin (United States, 1990).
rows.Bloom: Pink. Mild fragrance. Very double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b through 10b. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
